query: WITH matched AS ( SELECT s.id FROM series s WHERE s.normalized_title % $1 UNION SELECT st.series_id FROM series_titles st WHERE st.normalized % $1 ), ranked AS ( SELECT s.id, s.canonical_title, s.normalized_title, s.content_type, s.release_year, GREATEST( similarity(s.normalized_title, $1), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(similarity(st.normalized, $1)) FROM series_titles st WHERE st.series_id = s.id), 0) ) AS sim FROM series s JOIN matched m ON m.id = s.id ORDER BY sim DESC LIMIT $2 ) SELECT r.id AS series_id, r.canonical_title AS title, r.normalized_title, r.content_type::text AS "content_type!", r.release_year, (SELECT count(*) FROM series_sources ss WHERE ss.series_id = r.id) AS "source_count!", r.sim AS "similarity!" FROM ranked r ORDER BY r.sim DESC
